name: Alaric Draegoth, the Crimson Count

traits.name: Sanguine Cloak
traits.text: (1/turn) Deal 1d10 necrotic damage whenever you are hit, the attack is reduced by this amount.

traits.name: Sunscorn
traits.text: Vulnerable to radiant. After taking radiant damage, use Beguile as a Reaction, they roll with disadvantage.

actionsIntro: After each hero’s turn, summon 1 blood bat minion (d10) within 8 spaces, then choose 1:

actions.name: Ebonfang
actions.text: 1d10+15 damage, your target is considered Bloodied for 1 round. Fly 8 before or afterward.

actions.name: Beguile
actions.text: (If no one is Beguiled) Beguile a target on a failed DC 18 WIL save (w/ disadvantage if Bloodied).

actions.name: Beguiled
actions.text: Dazed. Cannot Defend or allow anyone to Interpose for you. Damage ends.

actions.name: Beckon
actions.text: Move a Beguiled creature adjacent to you and bite them: 2d10+30 damage and 1 Wound.

bloodied.text: At 160 HP, gain Mistform. No longer vulnerable to radiant. Bat Decoy. (1/round) Whenever Alaric would take damage, instead first swap places with a bat minion.

lastStand.text: Alaric is dying! 160 more damage and he dies. Until then, his Sanguine Cloak, attacks, and bats roll d20s instead of d10s.

flavor:
Count Alaric is an ancient Vampire of such profound power that nature and reality are warped by his presence. Where he settles, nights grow unnaturally long, as though the sun is afraid to rise. Beasts become rabid and vicious, vermin reproduce until they fill the alleys. Before long, locals become despondent and hopeless as the Vampires he spawns run amok, and spread to nearby settlements. Once a region collapses under his influence, he will search for new hunting grounds.

Alaric is rarely seen outside his estate, preferring his Thralls to bring him entertainment. Although he presents the air of a handsome sophisticate, Alaric is emotional, passionate, and prone to flights of fancy. The subjects of his obsessions are carelessly discarded the moment something else catches his eye. As long as the Count remains alive, everyone in his domain is in peril. If the heroes lack sufficient motivation, a friendly NPC may go missing, last seen at his estate.

tactics.easier:
Bats: They may clump up near hero with high armor, or one with an AoE ability. Or they may move twice and instead of attacking.
Beguile: Target heroes that are not Bloodied or ones with advantage on their WIL saves.
Beckon. Use this less often, use Ebonfang more.
Monologue. Arrogant and perilously self-absorbed, he may underestimate the heroes and spend a turn or two taunting them, telling them of his plans or insulting them for their impudence. "You'd make lovely thralls…"
tactics.harder:
Bats: Alaric is far deadlier with his bat swarms. If they’re being shut down, spread them out.
Mobility: Outdistance melee heroes using Ebonfang, targeting the back line with Beguile and Beckon at every opportunity.

notes: Header 'Level 16 Solo Vampire Lord'; actions intro printed after 'SOLO.'. 'Beguiled' bullet is a condition definition printed among the choices. Tactics are the page's 'To reduce/increase the difficulty' lists; separate 'Running Alaric' advice paragraph not included. Flavor is the two-paragraph page intro.

name: Flaming Skull

traits.name: Unliving, Undying
traits.text: (1 use) On death: reset to 1 HP.

actions.text: (Reach 10, 6x6 AoE) 8d6. Half damage on DC 13 DEX save.

flavor: The reanimated, floating skull of evil pyromaniac wizards. A mirthless laugh always heralds this horror wreathed in an ethereal flame.

tactics.easier: Center Fireblast on yourself! Don't move while laughing.
tactics.harder: Keep your distance, or distract with minions while you charge yourself.

name: Specter
flavor: Faint impressions left behind by particularly painful deaths—a common sight in dungeons.

tactics.easier: Attack only heroes who haven't yet Defend this round.
tactics.harder: Stay in the air, out of melee reach. Target heroes who have already defended—multiple Specters gets deadly, fast!

name: Ghost

traits.name: Start of Combat: Possess
traits.text: All heroes make a WIL save, the lowest is Possessed: Gain 1 action that only the Ghost can spend at will. The Ghost also takes damage whenever the hero does, and whenever they are healed.

flavor: Those with unfinished business in the mortal realm. Sometimes friendly, sometimes fearsome.

tactics.easier: Move the possessed hero, or make basic attacks. Allow the party to RP with you, and be convinced to act on their behalf.
tactics.harder: Use reactions so the possessed hero can’t. Interpose for monsters, negating an ally’s attack.

name: Wraith
flavor: Spirits of warriors denied a proper death a battle, or simply too angry to die.

tactics.easier: Attack unwounded heroes who have not yet defended.
tactics.harder: Focus on heroes who area already Dying, or isolated ones with no allies to Interpose for them.

name: Banshee

actions.name: Deathly Wail (1 use, Reach 12)
actions.text: DC 13 WIL save or drop to 0 HP, on save lose half your max HP. Advantage on the save if their hearing is adequately protected.

bloodied.name: Hold fast hope!
bloodied.text: (35hp) Any dying heroes gain 1 HP and 1 action.

lastStand.text: (30hp). Deathly Wail Recharges, use it immediately.

flavor: The longer a haunt or spirit remains on the mortal realm after their death, the more frayed their image becomes, the poorer the reflection of the self they once were. A banshee is a spirit stripped of all humanity. In their voice, their touch, even their gaze...the only thing left is cruel calousness.

tactics.easier: Wail from afar, before moving in. Give the heroes time to stabilize.
tactics.harder: Frighten and avoid melee heroes. Wail in the middle of the heroes, then immediately follow up on anyone who fails.

notes: Header 'lvl 3 solo, baleful horror'. Followed by a 'Note!' box: teach heroes to learn about dangerous monsters, and remind them they can retreat.

name: Grave Crow

tactics.easier: Clump up and attack heavily armored or high-health heroes that can easily shrug off their meager damage.
tactics.harder: Spread out and attack Dying heroes to inflict Wounds more quickly.

flavor: Fervently devoted servants of the dark.
